about: Laurentian Valley is a township in Renfrew County, Ontario, surrounding the separate Town of Pembroke on the Ottawa River—not Pembroke itself. Rural neighbourhoods, Ottawa Valley farmland, and hamlets such as Forest Lea and Pleasant View share the township’s land outside town limits. About 9,000 people live in Laurentian Valley Township.
